## Problem and use case

Describe who needs this and the problem it would solve. Avoid private user data or provider credentials.

## Proposed behavior

Explain the desired result and whether it applies to Free, Pro, or shared foundations. Both editions' source implementations are open source.

## Existing plans and alternatives

Link related issues or architecture documents. Describe alternatives and whether this extends an existing plan or proposes an architecture change.

## Scope and validation

Suggest a bounded first step, acceptance criteria, and any security or provider-policy considerations.
